I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It reproduces both examples and prints `error` with exit status 1 on a malformed 3×1 input that has only two rows. `wj build main.wj` also succeeded.

I only tested those three cases, plus the one malformed input. I didn't try other malformed inputs, such as a non-numeric first line, a row with too many integers, or blank lines between rows.
